study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Patterns of one-week systolic blood pressure changes post-admission
Patterns of one-week diastolic blood pressure changes post-admission
Diagnosis at admission (gestational hypertension or non-severe pre-eclampsia)
outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcome (severe maternal morbidity, mortality, post-partum hemorrhage, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 384 women with gestational hypertension or non-severe pre-eclampsia beyond 36 gestational weeks.
finding: A pattern of increasing diastolic blood pressure was significantly associated with an elevated risk of the composite adverse maternal outcome (OR 2.59, 95% CI 1.31, 5.13 or OR 2.09, 95% CI 1.02, 4.26, contingent on covariates).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was included as a component of the composite adverse maternal outcome.
